text:
The diagram shows gas particles hitting the wall of a container. The system is at room
temperature.
Why do the gas particles exert a pressure on the wall?
A
When the particles hit the wall, their momentum changes, which causes a force.
B
When the particles hit the wall, their average kinetic energy increases.
C
The particles expand when they hit the wall.
D
The particles collide with each other.
